classification.difficultyReason: A nested absolute value requires two successive inequality interpretations and careful retention of inclusive endpoints.

answer.short:
$-2\le x\le 0$ or $4\le x\le 6$.

Apply the outer absolute value inequality to obtain $2\le |x-2|\le 4$, then solve the two signed intervals.
answer.worked:
Apply the algebraic rule to the outer absolute value.
$$\begin{align*}-1 &\le 3-|x-2|\le 1\\2 &\le |x-2|\le 4\end{align*}$$
Split into the two signed intervals.
$$\begin{align*}-4 &\le x-2\le -2 \quad\text{or}\quad 2\le x-2\le 4\\-2 &\le x\le 0 \quad\text{or}\quad 4\le x\le 6\end{align*}$$
